title: Correctness: DO_KDF ikm_fd fget-fail leaves inbuf uncleared
description: Trigger: (1) open fd, (2) write(fd, bytes, N) accumulates N bytes in state->inbuf, (3) ioctl(fd, DO_KDF, op) where op.ikm_fd points to a non-crypto2dev fd or a closed fd. Path: ikm_fd != -1 branch allocates ikm_buf, then fget() returns NULL or f_op mismatch fires (lines 1819-1827), code does goto out_zero. out_zero frees ikm_buf but does NOT acquire state->lock and does NOT call inbuf_clear(). Result: state->inbuf retains the previously-written bytes. (4) User calls write(fd, more_bytes, M) — inbuf now holds N+M bytes. (5) User calls KEY_IMPORT with keylen == N+M — import proceeds with corrupted key material (old write data prepended). Same FIPS 140-3 zeroization violation as WOLFKM-s6t.11. Fix: add inbuf_clear() at out_zero (under state->lock), or restructure so out_zero always clears inbuf regardless of lock state.
close_reason: out_early now acquires state->lock and calls inbuf_clear before falling to out_zero; ikm_fd fget failures changed from goto out_zero to goto out_early
